meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.trans: Wait, I'll be right there.
Wait a minute.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'but, after all', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'родистый'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('thoroughbred / purebred').

examples.trans: On the other hand, he is a very thoroughbred pony.

meanings.en: to ask (a question, or someone: спросить у кого-то)

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'втра').

examples.trans: I will definitely return tomorrow.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'язательно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
